review.hma_carry_analysis: Non-HMA: POPF restores read carry immediately before register pops and JC. HMA: POPF restores read carry, then SHR CX,1 replaces CF with the low bit of DPB_SECTOR_SIZE; subsequent MOV, POP, CLD, MOVSW and JMP preserve CF before JC. DOS 6 restores saved read flags after SHR. Thus the target-matching source has different carry behavior on this branch. Reachability and runtime effects are not established.
